changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpreauthorizationsupportinginfo AS SELECT pasi.id, pasi.pre_authorization_id, pasi.sequence, pasi.category, pasi.code, pasi.from_date, pasi.to_date, pasi.value, pasi.reason, pasi.unit, pasi.attachment, pasi.attachment_name, pasi.attachment_type, pasi.attachment_date, pasi.created_date, pasi.created_by, pasi.last_modified_by, pasi.last_modified_date FROM public.pre_authorization_supporting_info pasi;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpreauthorizationsupportinginfo TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpreauthorizationsupportinginfo FROM report_user;
